subject: math
question: 计算积分 $\int \frac{\sqrt{x - 1}\arctan\sqrt{x - 1}}{x}\mathrm{d}x.$
answer: \begin{array}{r l} I & \xlongequal {\sqrt {x - 1} = t} 2 \int \frac {t ^ {2} \arctan t}{t ^ {2} + 1} \mathrm{d} t = 2 \int \arctan t \mathrm{d} t - 2 \int \frac {\arctan t}{t ^ {2} + 1} \mathrm{d} t \\ & = 2 t \arctan t - 2 \int \frac {t}{1 + t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t - 2 \int \arctan t \mathrm{d} \arctan t \\ & = 2 t \arctan t - \ln (1 + t ^ {2}) - (\arctan t) ^ {2} + C \\ & = 2 \sqrt {x - 1} \arctan

steps.text: 分析 按上例评注提供的方法，可得到几种不同的解法.

方法1 令 $t = \arctan \sqrt{x - 1}$ ，则 $\sqrt{x - 1} = \tan t, x = \sec^2 t, \mathrm{d}x = 2\sec^2 t\tan t\mathrm{d}t,$

$$
\begin{array}{r l} I & = \int \frac {\tan t \cdot t}{\sec^ {2} t} \cdot 2 \sec^ {2} t \tan t \mathrm{d} t = 2 \int t \tan^ {2} t \mathrm{d} t = 2 \int (t \sec^ {2} t - t) \mathrm{d} t \\ & = - t ^ {2} + 2 \int t \mathrm{d} \tan t = - t ^ {2} + 2 t \tan t + 2 \ln | \cos t | + C \\ & = - (\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2} + 2 \sqrt {x - 1} \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} - \ln x + C. \end{array}
$$

方法2 因 $\int \frac{\sqrt{x - 1}}{x}\mathrm{d}x\stackrel {\sqrt{x - 1} = t}{=}\int \frac{2t^2}{t^2 + 1}\mathrm{d}t = \int \left(2 - \frac{2}{t^2 + 1}\right)\mathrm{d}t = 2t - 2\arctan t + C$ ，则

$$
\begin{array}{r l} I & \xlongequal {\sqrt {x - 1} = t} 2 \int \arctan t \mathrm{d} (t - \arctan t) = 2 (t - \arctan t) \arctan t - 2 \int \frac {(t - \arctan t)}{1 + t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t \\ & = 2 (t - \arctan t) \arctan t - \ln (1 + t ^ {2}) + 2 \int \arctan t \mathrm{d} \arctan t \\ & = 2 t \arctan t - (\arctan t) ^ {2} - \ln (1 + t ^ {2}) + C \\ & = 2 \sqrt {x - 1} \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} - (\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2} - \ln x + C. \end{array}
$$

方法3

$$
\begin{array}{r l} I & \xlongequal {\sqrt {x - 1} = t} 2 \int \frac {t ^ {2} \arctan t}{t ^ {2} + 1} \mathrm{d} t = 2 \int \arctan t \mathrm{d} t - 2 \int \frac {\arctan t}{t ^ {2} + 1} \mathrm{d} t \\ & = 2 t \arctan t - 2 \int \frac {t}{1 + t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t - 2 \int \arctan t \mathrm{d} \arctan t \\ & = 2 t \arctan t - \ln (1 + t ^ {2}) - (\arctan t) ^ {2} + C \\ & = 2 \sqrt {x - 1} \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} - (\arctan \sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2} - \ln x + C. \end{array}
$$
